item.description: Background: Mindfulness-based interventions have been used for psychological care for people with various physical illnesses. item.description: Background: Coronary revascularization decision-making for patients with coronary artery disease (CAD) can be complex and challenging. item.description: Background: Mortality prediction in intensive care unit (ICU) patients with ischemic stroke complicated by intracranial artery stenosis or occlusion remains difficult. item.description: Background: Digital health solutions play a key role in health care, but their safe and effective use depends on patients’ digital health literacy. item.description: Background: Smart textiles (ie, electronic textiles) offer a promising solution to ease continuous electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring, but their real-world clinical application has been limited.
